name: Mafia Wife: Forbidden Affair
source:
Keeping secrets in this house is dangerous. Becoming one is worse.

Mafia Wife: Forbidden Affair is an adult visual novel about a forbidden romance behind the gates of a luxurious estate. You arrive as the new gardener and meet Marina, the wife of a powerful mafia boss. Beneath her perfect life lie loneliness, control and a longing to choose her own future.

A conversation by the pool. An invitation for coffee. A message after dark. Every moment together makes your secret harder to keep. Build trust, watch the growing suspicion and decide where this relationship will lead: a carefully guarded romance, a decisive step into the open or the distance you both need.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5145090/Mafia_Wife_Forbidden_Affair/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在这座宅邸里保守秘密很危险，而自己沦为秘密本身则更加致命。

《黑帮人妻：禁忌偷情》是一部讲述奢华庄园高墙之内禁忌恋情的成人视觉小说。你作为新雇来的园丁踏入庄园，结识了权势滔天的黑帮老大之妻玛丽娜。在她光鲜完美的生活表象之下，掩藏着孤独、严密的控制，以及亲手决定自己未来的深切渴望。

泳池畔的一次交谈、共饮咖啡的一句邀约、入夜后的一条私信——相处的每一刻都让你们的秘密变得愈发难以掩藏。建立信任、警惕日渐滋长的猜忌，决定这段感情最终的归宿：是小心翼翼守护到底的地下恋情，是孤注一掷走向台前的果断一步，还是留给彼此最需要的安全距离。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5145090/Mafia_Wife_Forbidden_Affair/]Steam[/url]]
